_desk_core_comment.status: Intrinsics calibrated at 1280x720 (wrist rmse=0.18px, scene->top rmse=0.24px). Note: desk_core maps 'scene' -> 'top' automatically.

required_missing_for_3d_pick.T_world_cam_top (or scene.T_world_cam): REQUIRED for metric depth & 3D pixel_to_world from top camera: 4x4 transform from cam2 optical frame -> ElRobot base_link (meters).
required_missing_for_3d_pick.z_table: REQUIRED for ray-plane projection: tabletop height (meters) in ElRobot base_link frame.
required_missing_for_3d_pick.H_table: OPTIONAL (or REQUIRED if skipping T_world_cam_top): 3x3 4-corner homography mapping 1280x720 top pixels -> tabletop (X, Y) at z_table.

required_missing_for_wrist_3d.T_ee_cam_wrist (or wrist.T_ee_cam): REQUIRED for eye-in-hand 3D depth/projection: 4x4 fixed transform from cam1 optical frame -> Gripper_Base_v1_1.

required_missing_for_joints_and_ik.joint_zero_ticks: REQUIRED for real arm motion: ST3215 ticks {'1':..,'7':..} matching ElRobot URDF zero pose (defaults to range midpoint if omitted).
required_missing_for_joints_and_ik.joint_signs: REQUIRED if any servo direction is inverted vs URDF: {'1': +/-1, ..., '7': +/-1} (defaults to +1).

optional_for_station_routing.hardware: OPTIONAL if already set in .env: {'bus_serial': '...', 'camera_top': '...', 'camera_wrist': '...'}. Note /dev/video0 & /dev/video4 are Station-local V4L2 nodes; NormFS needs unique_id/product substrings from scripts/probe_station.py.

_desk_core_comment.note_edge_coverage: Calibration edge_coverage reported bottom=false (both) and left/right=false (scene); monitor corner accuracy near image edges.
